1_platform_registration.description: Register your platform to get an API Key

2_single_invite_multi_prop.description: Invite a new tenant with multiple properties in one go
2_single_invite_multi_prop.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/v1/single/invite -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"company": {"name": "Global Living Ltd"}, "invite": {"user": {"email": "tenant_new@example.com", "firstName": "Jane", "lastName": "Doe"}, "properties": [{"location": {"country": "Nigeria", "state": "Lagos", "area": "Ikoyi", "address": "10 Bourdillon"}, "rent": {"rentAmount": 5000000, "rentEndDate": "2025-12-31"}, "manager": {"firstName": "Bisi", "lastName": "Staff", "email": "bisi@global.com"}}, {"location": {"country": "Nigeria", "state": "Lagos", "area": "Lekki", "address": "Unit 5, Royal Estate"}, "rent": {"rentAmount": 2500000, "rentEndDate": "2025-06-30"}}]}}'

3_add_properties_to_existing.description: Add more properties to an existing user (Requires User UUID and Company UUID)

4_payment_request_standard.description: Create a payment request for an existing verified property (Requires Property UUID)
4_payment_request_standard.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/v1/payment-request -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"userPropertyUuid": "PROPERTY_UUID_HERE", "dueDate": "2024-12-31", "amount": 50000, "description": "Maintenance Fee Dec 2024", "bankCode": "058", "accountNumber": "0123456789"}'

5_atomic_payment_and_invite.description: Invite a user and issue a payment request in a single atomic call (Cold Start)
5_atomic_payment_and_invite.curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/v1/payment-request -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"dueDate": "2024-12-25", "amount": 120000, "bankCode": "011", "accountNumber": "9876543210", "description": "Initial Move-in Deposit", "invite": {"company": {"name": "Premium Property Group"}, "invite": {"user": {"email": "user_atomic@example.com", "firstName": "Sam", "lastName": "Smith"}, "properties": [{"location": {"country": "Nigeria", "state": "Lagos", "area": "Victoria Island", "address": "Adetokunbo Ademola St"}, "rent": {"rentAmount": 8000000, "rentEndDate": "2026-01-01"}}]}}}'

notes: 1. Start by registering your platform to get an 'apiKey'.
3. Use Section 2 or 5 to create a user and get their UUID, then try Section 3 or 4.
4. 'isVerified' is set to true for all properties created via these APIs, protecting them from manual user edits.
